segments.name: Salix
segments.description: Sells gastroenterology products in the U.S., led by the Xifaxan product line.
segments.evidence: The Salix segment consists of sales in the U.S. of GI products.

segments.name: International
segments.description: Sells branded, branded generic and OTC pharmaceutical products outside the U.S.
segments.evidence: The International segment consists of sales, with the exception of sales of Bausch + Lomb products and Solta Medical aesthetic medical devices, outside the U.S. of branded pharmaceutical products, branded generic pharmaceutical products and OTC products.

segments.name: Solta Medical
segments.description: Sells aesthetic medical devices globally, primarily skin tightening technologies.
segments.evidence: The Solta Medical segment consists of global sales of Solta Medical aesthetic medical devices.

segments.name: Diversified
segments.description: Sells U.S. neurology, dermatology, generic and dentistry pharmaceutical products.
segments.evidence: The Diversified segment consists of sales in the U.S. of: (i) pharmaceutical products in the areas of neurology and certain other therapeutic classes, (ii) dermatology products, (iii) generic pharmaceutical products and (iv) dentistry products.

segments.name: Bausch + Lomb
segments.description: Sells eye health products globally, including contact lenses, surgical devices and ophthalmic pharmaceuticals.
segments.evidence: The Bausch + Lomb segment consists of global sales of Bausch + Lomb Vision Care, Surgical and Pharmaceuticals products.
